# Same-module paired-screen source plan

This three-file checkpoint is a plan only. It executes no screen, timing, profiler, build or new candidate. The original 72-unit tranche is sealed; the prior source-v5 infrastructure RED and the existing 192 kHz steady timing RED remain retained. Root review and all-agent quiet acknowledgment precede any future timing release.

`PLAN.json` binds the same existing baseline/candidate GoJS modules and runtime, exact effective 6/7 source mappings, actual semantic and original-unit indices, and unchanged old screen/test/helper hashes. The frozen screen producer expects different module paths, a nine-source inventory, old 14/6 mappings and corresponding-label archives. A future minimal host binding must use the graph BUILD directly and both sides' accepted e492 candidate archives, without rewriting or mislabeling old manifests. All new adapter source must be indexed. The plan reuses already sealed 192 kHz recorder bytes/receipts; it does not propose another fixture run or build.

The original method stays: 192 kHz Tube/Optical, makeup12/dither24; steady and peaky inputs; finite then repeat; 64 warm blocks, 32 verification blocks; reset0,64 warm,32 measured128-frame blocks. Two verification children per workload must pass without timing before a separately released baseline-before/candidate/baseline-after triplet. Original byte/state/clock equality, allocation observations, limits and closed filesystem/post-exit rules remain unchanged. No constructor, traversal, hash or I/O moves into the timed loop; no overhead is subtracted. The unit host's heap flags/RSS polling must not be silently added to the old screen method.

One lifecycle prerequisite remains visible: the immutable old parent supervisor registers its selector before owned cleanup. A future launcher needs a separately reviewed guarded ownership path; old helper bytes stay unchanged. No adapter implementation or synthetic pass is claimed by this plan.

A 32-block mean supplies no callback maximum, physical deadline, browser continuity or headroom certificate. Only12,288 post-reset frames are reached from a16,777,216-frame declaration; no source wrap, EOF, drain or physical steady state follows. All first valid results must be retained, including RED. Coarse stack sampling suggests no further admitted exact-arithmetic change; qualified Go and the envelope payload remain unchanged.
